definition: Torch is an open-source machine learning library, a scientific computing framework, and a scripting language based on Lua.
details: It provides LuaJIT interfaces to deep learning algorithms implemented in C. It was created by the Idiap Research Institute. Torch development moved in 2017 to PyTorch, a port of the library to Python.

explainer.lead: Torch is an open-source machine learning library, scientific computing framework, and scripting language based on Lua. It matters as an early deep learning framework whose line continued when development moved to PyTorch.

tiers.eli5: Torch is an older toolbox for building machine-learning programs, written in a language called Lua. In 2017 the project moved over to PyTorch, a version of the same idea for the Python language.
tiers.practitioner: It provides LuaJIT interfaces to deep learning algorithms implemented in C. A pitfall for new work is that development moved in 2017 to PyTorch, the port of the library to Python.
tiers.paperLevel: Torch is an open-source machine learning library and scientific computing framework with a scripting language based on Lua, offering LuaJIT interfaces to deep learning algorithms implemented in C. It was created by the Idiap Research Institute.

explainer.example: A researcher using Torch writes Lua scripts that call, through LuaJIT, deep learning algorithms implemented in C.
